# bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/nolb_nma

## Summary

Wrapper of the NOLB tool

Generate an ensemble of structures using the NOLB (NOn-Linear rigid Block) NMA tool.

Nextflow adapter of the [Nolb_nma](https://biobb-flexdyn.readthedocs.io/en/latest/flexdyn.html#module-flexdyn.nolb) building block of [biobb_flexdyn](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_FLEXDYN_NOLB_NMA } from 'bioexcel/biobb_flexdyn/nolb_nma'

workflow {
    BIOBB_FLEXDYN_NOLB_NMA(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Input PDB file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Output multi-model PDB file with the generated ensemble |
| `versions_biobb_flexdyn` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_flexdyn', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Nolb_nma properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pdb_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_flexdyn container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_FLEXDYN_NOLB_NMA' {
        ext.properties = [binary_path: 'NOLB']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `binary_path` | string | "NOLB" | NOLB binary path to be used. |
| `num_structs` | integer | 500 | Number of structures to be generated |
| `cutoff` | number | 5.0 | This options specifies the interaction cutoff distance for the elastic network models (in angstroms), 5 by default. The Hessian matrix is constructed according to this interaction distance. Some artifacts should be expected for too short distances (< 5 Å). |
| `rmsd` | number | 1.0 | Maximum RMSd for decoy generation. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
